title: My Tho in a day
summary: Eat hủ tiếu, give Vĩnh Tràng about 120 minutes, and end at the statue in vườn hoa Lạc Hồng.

stops.name: Hu tieu My Tho
stops.note: Eat the bowl dry or in the broth, at breakfast, lunch, or supper.

stops.name: Vinh Trang Pagoda
stops.note: Walk the ceramic gate and the five-tower hall for about 120 minutes.

stops.name: Thu Khoa Huan statue
stops.note: Pause at the statue in vườn hoa Lạc Hồng on the evening walk.

additions.name: Thoi Son islet
additions.note: Take the morning boat from the pier at 01 Hoàng Sa.

seoTitle: My Tho in a day — bowl, pagoda, embankment
seoDescription: A My Tho day: hủ tiếu, about 120 minutes at Vinh Trang, and the statue on the embankment. Thoi Son is the morning boat.
